commits.message:
Markdown draws a character reference as the characters it names, as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.krtk)

Inline text decodes named, decimal and hex references by markdown-it's entity
rule, an invalid numeric one as U+FFFD; a link's destination goes through
markdown-it's unescapeAll before its href is made, so [a](javascript:x)
is refused as Rich refuses it. The named table is HTML5's, generated from
Python's html.entities.html5 by scripts/html-entities.py.

Markdown draws an autolink as Rich does, and makes every link's href as markdown-it does (rich-unfiled-791c.95jg) (#426)

* Markdown draws an autolink as Rich does, and makes every link's href as markdown-it does (rich-unfiled-791c.95jg)

`<http://e.com>` and `<a@b.co>` now draw as links whose text is the address,
an email linking to mailto:. Links, images and autolinks all take their href
from src/renderables/markdown-url.ts, a port of markdown-it-py's
normalizeLink / normalizeLinkText / validateLink with the mdurl and punycode
pieces they stand on — so a javascript:, vbscript:, file: or non-image data:
URL is no link, as in Rich. Tests pinned against Rich 14 output.

* Markdown draws an image's alt text and an unhyperlinked label as Rich does, and scans an autolink in one pass (rich-unfiled-791c.95jg)

Review (high): Rich draws alt text as written and a link label without
hyperlinks as plain text in markdown.link; both pinned against Rich 14.
autolinkAt stops at the first < or >, as markdown-it does, and an
autolink's display text is decoded only when drawn.

* Markdown strips a link's whitespace in one pass, as Python's str.strip does (rich-unfiled-791c.95jg)

Review (medium): the trailing alternative of PY_STRIP backtracked over
every interior whitespace run, so a URL holding 200k U+3000 took 43 s;
pyStrip scans in from each end and takes 25 ms.

* Markdown links nothing without hyperlinks and nothing to an empty URL, as Rich does (rich-unfiled-791c.95jg)

Review (high, escalation): Rich attaches no link when hyperlinks is
false, and its Style reads an empty link as none, so Style now takes an
empty URL as no link. mdurl's protocol is matched as Python's
IGNORECASE matches it, which folds four non-ASCII letters into [a-z].
